description: Add a task to an additional list (Tasks in Multiple Lists). This preserves the task ID and all data (comments, history) across both lists. Useful for cross-project tracking.

listId.description: ID of the list to add the task to.

listName.description: Name of the list to add the task to (used if listId is not provided).

taskListName.description: Current list name of the task (helps resolve duplicate task names).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: add_task_to_list
